description: Builds addresses for PlaceMellon, the Carnegie Mellon placeholder image service: campus photos, Scotty, profile pictures and solid colors at any size. Includes a Rails view helper.

author: Sophie Déziel
description: A type-safe Ruby wrapper for PrusaLink, the local web API of Prusa 3D printers (MK4, MK3.9, MK3.5, XL, MINI, Core One and MK3 with a Raspberry Pi). Supports printer status, jobs, storage, transfers and file uploads with HTTP Digest authentication.
